cases.title: Full-screen canvas with live node cards
steps: Start a --web run on the diamond fixture with the fake script {"task:3":{"attempts":[{"hang":true}]}} as TESTING.md "Web view" describes
Open the URL with agent-browser at 1280x800 and evaluate document.documentElement.scrollHeight <= innerHeight
Repeat on the suite page started with demo/suite/run.sh
cases.expected: No page scroll on either page; node cards show status, provider, elapsed time and +/− counts; the running node has the running class and pulses

cases.title: Right panel resizes and remembers its width
steps: Click a finished node to open the right panel
Drag the panel's left-edge handle until the panel is about 75% of the viewport
Reload the page and open a node again
cases.expected: The panel keeps the ~75% width after reload (localStorage ge.panel), and the graph canvas shrinks instead of being covered

cases.title: Diff viewer: file tree, highlighting, split view
steps: Open the Changes tab of a node that changed a .ts or .json file
Click a file in the file tree, then switch to Split with the panel at least 900px wide
cases.expected: The file tree shows status and +/− counts; the diff has highlight.js colour classes (hljs-*); split view shows old and new side by side

cases.title: Expand context between hunks
steps: Open a diff with hidden lines between or around hunks
Click expand once
curl GET /file?node=<id>&path=<file>&from=1&to=5
cases.expected: 20 more context lines with correct line numbers appear; curl returns {path, from, to, lines, total}

cases.title: Review tab on both pages
steps: Start a run with --human-review --web (TESTING.md "Human review") and open the URL
In the Review tab add a line comment, press Request changes, wait for round 2, then Apply
Repeat with demo/suite/run.sh --human-review
cases.expected: The Review tab opens in the right panel with a sticky decision bar; Request changes, the round 2 fixer notes and verdicts, and Apply work as before on both pages

cases.title: Live logs stream
steps: During a run with the hang script, select task 3 and open the Logs tab
Append a line with echo hello >> <runDir>/logs/3.log
Scroll the log up, append again
cases.expected: hello appears within 1.5 s; after scrolling up the view stays put and a new-lines chip appears

cases.title: Narrow window
steps: Set the viewport to 800x900 and click a node
cases.expected: The panel opens as a full-screen sheet with a ← Graph button that returns to the canvas

cases.title: Assets are local and safe
steps: curl -i http://127.0.0.1:<port>/assets/theme.css
curl -i --path-as-is http://127.0.0.1:<port>/assets/../package.json
Check network requests in agent-browser while loading the page
cases.expected: theme.css is 200 text/css; the traversal is 404; the page makes no requests to hosts other than 127.0.0.1
